checklist.label: Scope — matches the PR's intent, no unrelated changes mixed in
Compatibility — contracts/APIs/schemas preserved or safely migrated
Tests — adequate coverage for the change, including edge cases
Maintainability — readable, consistent with project conventions
Security — authn/authz, input validation, no sensitive data exposure
Data integrity — no data loss/corruption risk
Concurrency/state — safe under simultaneous or repeated execution
Performance — no N+1s, unbounded queries, or scalability issues
Design/architecture — backend pattern and structure fit the change
UI correctness — loading/empty/error states handled, matches requirement
State management — no stale/duplicated state or race conditions
Frontend security — no XSS, unsafe raw HTML, or secrets exposed client-side
Accessibility — keyboard navigation, semantic HTML, ARIA where needed
Responsive/cross-browser — works across viewport sizes and browsers
